streamingProfile.operation: Sequentially hash and closed-schema validate every JSONL record; label files are small bounded arrays; per-split signature sets support exact duplicate accounting without constructing a semantic graph.
streamingProfile.hostObservation: 2026-08-11 local run with Node.js 22; measurements describe this source and machine, not an acceptance quota.

storagePlan: The immutable archive and six extracted source files remain under training/.cache. The three official split files are already source-native shards. Development materialization is bounded to 1,532 label-free tasks. Train is streamed only when requested; official test has no exported loader. No KB compilation is performed in this integration.
queryAndCachePlan: The adapter selects one official split by a fixed local path and sequentially reads only that split. There is no approximate routing, cross-split preload, corpus execution, or runtime network access.
sizePolicy: No valid record is rejected because of file size, row count, text length, duplicate source context, or anomaly class.
